_note: Rule table. UI rules page and src/rules.py both read this. Check every citation against the source text before the demo.

rules.name: Wake turbulence separation
rules.rule: Keep the minimum separation behind the preceding aircraft by wake category (Heavy / Medium / Light).
rules.simplification: We use time gaps (3 min behind Heavy, 2 min behind Medium) instead of distance in NM.

rules.name: Arrival slot capacity
rules.rule: Arrivals per 10-minute slot may not exceed the weather-reduced acceptance rate.
rules.source: Assumption: real same-day arrival count x weather factor (clear 1.0, fog 0.6, thunderstorm 0.5)
rules.simplification: Real AAR is set by the tower per runway configuration; we scale the observed count.

rules.name: Landing fuel minimum
rules.rule: Fuel on landing must stay above the regulatory reserve.
rules.source: 14 CFR 121.639 (US domestic). ICAO Annex 6 applies internationally.
rules.simplification: Fuel is simulated as minutes of endurance; holding burns 1 min per min, slow-down burns 0.4.

rules.name: Gate conflict
rules.rule: Two aircraft may not occupy the same gate at the same time, with a 10-minute buffer.
rules.simplification: Gate occupancy table is simulated per scenario.

rules.name: Passenger connections
rules.rule: Arriving after the connection cutoff costs one missed connection per affected passenger.
rules.simplification: Counted as cost, never a veto.
